Matchless Travels specializes in family Umrah packages from Canada, ensuring that every member of your family — from young children to grandparents — travels comfortably, safely, and spiritually prepared. Based in Mississauga and serving families across the Greater Toronto Area, Mississauga, Brampton, Milton, and all of Canada, we have helped hundreds of families perform Umrah together. Our 136+ five-star Google reviews speak to the care we bring to every family journey. What Makes a Family Umrah Package Different? Family travel to Makkah and Madinah has unique requirements that standard individual packages do not address. At Matchless Travels, our family packages are designed to handle every detail: Seats together on the flight — We coordinate seating so your family travels as a group from Toronto Pearson (YYZ) Connecting or adjoining hotel rooms — Families are accommodated in connecting rooms or family suites near the Haram Child Umrah visa processing — We handle visa applications for all family members, including children Family-friendly scheduling — We help plan Tawaf and Sa'i at times that work for young children and elderly family members Private transfers available — Avoid crowded shared shuttles with private vehicle options for your family Group coordination — One dedicated contact for your entire family booking Family Umrah Package Tiers We offer three tiers of family Umrah packages, each fully customizable based on your family size and travel dates. Diamond Family Umrah Package The premium choice for families who want the very best. 5-star hotels within steps of Masjid al-Haram in Makkah and the Prophet’s Mosque in Madinah. Spacious rooms, premium catering, and maximum comfort for every family member. View Diamond Umrah Packages Gold Family Umrah Package Our most popular family tier. Comfortable 4-star accommodation with easy access to the Haram. The right balance of quality, proximity, and value for Canadian families. Ideal for families of 3–8 people. View Gold Umrah Packages Silver Family Umrah Package An affordable, well-organized option for larger families or those performing Umrah for the first time. 3-star hotels with all essentials included — visa, flights, accommodation, and transfers. View Silver Umrah Packages Frequently Asked Questions — Family Umrah from Canada Can children perform Umrah? Yes. Children of any age can perform Umrah. There is no minimum age requirement. Saudi Arabia issues Umrah visas for children when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Matchless Travels handles all child visa documentation on your behalf. What is the best age to bring children for Umrah? Many families choose to bring children aged 5 and older, as they are old enough to appreciate the experience and manage the physical demands of Tawaf and Sa’i. However, many families also bring infants and toddlers successfully. We help you plan based on your family’s specific situation. Do family members get rooms together? Yes. We specifically request connecting or adjacent rooms for all family bookings. For larger families, we can arrange suites or multiple connecting rooms. This is coordinated directly with the hotels in Makkah and Madinah. How much does a family Umrah package cost from Canada? Family Umrah package pricing depends on the number of family members, travel dates, and hotel tier selected. As a general guide: Silver packages start from approximately $2,500 CAD per adult, Gold from $2,750 CAD, and Diamond from $3,200 CAD. Children’s pricing varies by age and airline. Contact us for a custom family quote. Can we travel as an extended family group? Absolutely. Matchless Travels handles group bookings of all sizes — from immediate families of 4 to extended family groups of 20 or more. Larger groups may qualify for group discounts. Call us at (289) 643-6663 to discuss your group’s needs. Can elderly family members travel on Umrah packages? Yes. We have extensive experience arranging Umrah for senior pilgrims. We coordinate wheelchair assistance at airports and in Makkah and Madinah, request ground-floor or elevator-accessible hotel rooms, and advise on the best times to perform rituals to avoid peak crowds. Do you offer Ramadan family Umrah packages? Yes. Ramadan Umrah is a deeply special experience for families. We offer dedicated Ramadan Umrah packages with early booking strongly recommended, as availability is limited during this peak season. CA US PK Show Sidebar Home Umrah Guide Umrah Guide How Much Does Umrah Cost from Canada in 2026? How Much Does Umrah Cost from Canada in 2026? If you’re planning Umrah from Canada, one of the first questions you’ll ask is: how much will it cost? The answer depends on several factors — your departure city, travel dates, hotel tier, and the type of package you choose. This guide breaks down the real cost of Umrah from Canada in 2026, including what’s included in a package, what’s not, and how to get the best value for your budget. Umrah Package Prices from Canada — 2026 At Matchless Travels, we offer three tiers of Umrah packages departing from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD) and are per person based on double occupancy. Silver Umrah Package — Starting from $2,400 CAD Our most affordable tier. Includes return flights from Toronto (YYZ), 3-star hotel accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, Umrah visa, airport transfers, and intercity transport. Ideal for first-time pilgrims and budget-conscious travellers. View Silver Umrah Packages Gold Umrah Package — Starting from $2,750 CAD Our most popular tier. Everything in Silver, plus 4-star hotel accommodation with closer proximity to Masjid al-Haram. The best balance of comfort and value for Canadian pilgrims. View Gold Umrah Packages Diamond Umrah Package — Starting from $3,200 CAD Our premium tier. 5-star hotels within walking distance of the Haram in both Makkah and Madinah. Spacious rooms, premium service, and maximum comfort for a truly exceptional pilgrimage. View Diamond Umrah Packages What is Included in a Canadian Umrah Package? A complete Umrah package from Matchless Travels includes all of the following: Return flights from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) to Jeddah or Madinah Umrah visa — full application processing for Canadian citizens and permanent residents Hotel accommodation in Makkah — based on tier selected (3-star, 4-star, or 5-star) Hotel accommodation in Madinah — based on tier selected Airport transfers — on arrival and departure Intercity transport — between Makkah and Madinah What is NOT Included? Meals (unless specifically stated in your package — ask your agent) Personal spending money and shopping Travel insurance (strongly recommended — we can advise) Optional Ziyarah (historical site tours) — available as an add-on Ihram garments and Umrah supplies Factors That Affect Umrah Package Prices from Canada 1. Travel Season Umrah prices vary significantly by season. The most expensive periods are Ramadan (especially the last 10 nights), school holidays, and the months immediately before Hajj. The most affordable months are typically May through September (excluding Ramadan) and January through February. 2. Hotel Distance from the Haram Hotels within 200 metres of Masjid al-Haram in Makkah cost significantly more than hotels 500 metres or 1 kilometre away. Our Diamond tier places you in the closest hotels available; Silver tier uses quality hotels within a 5–10 minute walk. 3. Package Duration Standard Umrah packages from Canada are typically 10–14 nights. Longer packages (21–28 nights) are available and priced accordingly. 4. Flight Availability Direct flights from Toronto to Jeddah or Madinah are not always available. Many packages connect through Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi, or Istanbul. The number of stops and airline selected affects the price. 5. Group Size Families and groups of 6 or more may qualify for group discounts. Contact us to discuss group Umrah pricing. Is Umrah Cheaper to Book Directly or Through a Travel Agency? Booking through a TICO-registered Canadian travel agency like Matchless Travels is almost always the smarter choice. Here’s why: Visa processing — We handle the Saudi Umrah visa on your behalf. Doing it independently requires navigating the Nusuk platform and specific document requirements Hotel proximity knowledge — We know which hotels are genuinely close to the Haram vs. which ones market themselves misleadingly Flight coordination — We bundle flights and hotels so your timing between Makkah and Madinah is properly coordinated Consumer protection — As a TICO-registered agency, your booking is protected under Ontario’s Travel Industry Act Support on the ground — If something goes wrong with your hotel or transfer, you have someone to call Umrah Cost FAQ — Canada 2026 How much spending money do I need for Umrah in 2026? Beyond your package cost, most pilgrims budget $500–$1,500 CAD for meals, shopping, and personal expenses over a 10–14 night trip. Makkah and Madinah have abundant food options at all price points near the Haram. Do I need travel insurance for Umrah? Travel insurance is strongly recommended. It covers trip cancellations, medical emergencies, and lost luggage. We can recommend appropriate travel insurance for your Umrah journey. Can I pay for my Umrah package in installments? Yes. Matchless Travels offers flexible payment plans. Contact us at (289) 643-6663 to discuss deposit and installment options for your package. When should I book to get the best price? We recommend booking at least 3–4 months in advance for regular season travel, and 5–6 months in advance for Ramadan Umrah. Early booking secures better hotel proximity and flight availability. Are there additional fees for Umrah from Canada? The Saudi government does not currently charge a separate Umrah fee for first-time pilgrims. There are standard visa processing fees included in all Matchless Travels packages. Get a Custom Umrah Price Quote Every pilgrim’s situation is different. The best way to get an accurate cost for your Umrah from Canada is to speak with our team directly. We will build a package around your travel dates, budget, and family needs. Phone: (289) 643-6663 Email: contact@matchlesstravels.ca Address: 2550 Argentia Road, Suite 107, Mississauga, ON L5N 5R1 View All Umrah Packages | Contact Us Umrah Cost from Canada — Frequently Asked Questions How much does an Umrah package cost from Canada? Group Umrah packages from Canada start around CAD $2,049 per person (quad room) and range up to about CAD $3,349 depending on travel month, room type and package tier. Diamond, Gold and Silver tiers are available to suit different budgets. What is included in the package price? Our group packages include Saudia Airlines flights from Toronto (YYZ), 3–4 star hotels with breakfast, ground transportation, Ziyarat tours, the Makkah–Madinah high-speed train, Zam Zam water and Ihram — with an Imam accompanying group departures. Is the Umrah visa included in the package? The visa is not included in the package price. Our team handles the entire visa process for you — contact us for current visa costs. What is the cheapest time to perform Umrah from Canada? Non-peak months typically offer the lowest prices, while Ramadan is the most expensive period. October departures are currently among the most affordable, starting from CAD $2,049 per person. Are there group Umrah departures from Toronto? Yes — Matchless Travels runs Imam-led group Umrah departures with Saudia Airlines in August, October and December 2026. Matchless

CA US PK Home Umrah Package from Montreal | Matchless Travels Umrah Package from Montreal | Matchless Travels Umrah Package from Montreal, Quebec Matchless Travels is a TICO-registered Umrah travel agency based in Mississauga, Ontario, and we welcome pilgrims from Montreal and across Quebec every season. Our Imam-led group departures fly from Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ) on Saudia Airlines, and Montreal’s large, established Muslim community makes it one of the cities we hear from most outside the GTA when families are planning their Umrah package. We know that booking an Umrah package from another province means trusting an agency you may never have visited in person. Our team is available by phone and email throughout your planning, from choosing between our Diamond, Gold and Silver tiers to confirming your Montreal-to-Toronto connection, so you always know exactly where things stand before you fly. Connecting to Toronto from Montreal-Trudeau (YUL) Montreal-Trudeau International Airport (YUL) is about a one-to-one-and-a-half-hour flight from Toronto Pearson, or roughly a five-to-five-and-a-half-hour drive along Highway 401. Montreal pilgrims typically choose one of two paths with us: Fly YUL to YYZ: Connect to Toronto and join the scheduled group departure on Saudia Airlines, travelling with a qualified Imam for the whole journey. Customized Umrah from Montreal: For pilgrims who prefer not to route through Toronto, our Customized Umrah service can build a personalized package with flights arranged from YUL. Reach out to our team as early as possible so we can help coordinate your Montreal connection with the correct group departure date. Umrah Package Tiers for Montreal Travellers All three of our package tiers include Umrah visa processing, hotel accommodation in Makkah and Madinah, airport transfers, and ground transportation between the holy cities. Diamond Umrah Package 5-star hotels within walking distance of the Haram in Makkah and the Prophet’s Mosque in Madinah, our premium tier. Starting from approximately $3,200 CAD per person. View Diamond Umrah Packages Gold Umrah Package 4-star hotels close to the Haram, the most popular choice among our clients for value and comfort. Starting from approximately $2,750 CAD per person. View Gold Umrah Packages Silver Umrah Package 3-star hotels covering every essential, a solid starting point for first-time pilgrims from Montreal. Starting from approximately $2,400 CAD per person. View Silver Umrah Packages For a complete breakdown of Umrah pricing factors, see How Much Does Umrah Cost from Canada in 2026? Why Montreal Pilgrims Trust Matchless Travels 136+ Google reviews at 4.6★ from pilgrims across Canada TICO-registered Ontario travel agency, with booking protection under the Travel Industry Act Family-friendly planning , seating together, family rooms, and support with children’s visas Experience with Quebec pilgrims connecting through Toronto for group departures Group Departure Months for 2026 Matchless Travels currently has confirmed Imam-led group Umrah departures on Saudia Airlines in August, October and December 2026 . Montreal pilgrims can plan their YUL-to-YYZ connection around these dates: August 2026 Umrah Packages October 2026 Umrah Packages December 2026 Umrah Packages See the full year-round schedule on our main Umrah Packages page. Umrah Package from Montreal, Frequently Asked Questions Is there an Umrah package that departs directly from Montreal? Not currently. Our group departures fly from Toronto Pearson (YYZ) on Saudia Airlines. Montreal pilgrims generally connect through Toronto, given the short flight or drive between the two cities. How do Montreal pilgrims get to the Toronto departure? Most fly YUL to YYZ (about one to one-and-a-half hours), while some prefer to drive down Highway 401, a trip of roughly five to five-and-a-half hours. What does an Umrah package from Montreal cost? Package pricing is consistent nationally, from approximately $2,400 CAD (Silver), $2,750 CAD (Gold) and $3,200 CAD (Diamond) per person, plus your travel cost to Toronto. Contact us for an exact quote based on your dates. Can you build a custom Umrah itinerary departing from Montreal? Yes. Through our Customized Umrah service, we can arrange an itinerary with flights routed from YUL rather than connecting through Toronto. Do you handle the Umrah visa for Quebec residents? Yes. Matchless Travels manages the full Umrah visa application for Canadian citizens and permanent residents across every province, including Quebec. How early should Montreal pilgrims book their Umrah package? We recommend booking at least three to four months in advance for regular season travel, and five to six months ahead for Ramadan Umrah, so we can confirm your Montreal connection alongside your hotel and group departure dates. CA US PK Home Privacy Policy Privacy Policy Last updated: October 27, 2026 Matchless Travels Inc. (“Matchless Travels”, “we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information when you use matchlesstravels.ca (the “Website”) or book travel with us. We follow Canada’s Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). 1. Information We Collect Contact details: name, phone number, email address, and mailing address. Booking details: traveller names, dates of birth, passport and visa information, travel dates, preferences, and special requests (such as meal or accessibility needs). Payment details: payment amounts and transaction records. Card details are processed by secure third-party payment processors and are not stored on our Website. Communications: messages you send us through our forms, email, phone, or WhatsApp. Website usage data: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and cookies (see Section 5). 2. How We Use Your Information To respond to your inquiries and provide quotes. To make, confirm, change, and manage your bookings with airlines, hotels, and other travel suppliers. To process payments, refunds, and invoices. To assist with visas and travel documents, including for Umrah and Hajj. To send booking updates and, with your consent, offers and newsletters. You can unsubscribe at any time. To improve our Website, services, and advertising. To meet legal, regulatory, and TICO record-keeping requirements. 3. Consent By providing your personal information, you consent to its use as described in this policy. If you book on behalf of other travellers, you confirm you have their permission to share their information with us. You may withdraw consent at any time, subject to legal or contractual limits, but this may affect our ability to complete your booking. 4. Who We Share Your Information With We do not sell your personal information. We share it only as needed to provide our services: Travel suppliers: airlines, hotels, tour operators, transport providers, and insurance providers that deliver your trip. Government authorities: embassies, consulates, and immigration or customs authorities when required for visas or entry, or when required by law. Service providers: payment processors, booking and reservation systems, customer relationship management (CRM) software, email and messaging services, website hosting, and analytics providers. These providers may only use your information to perform services for us. 5. Cookies and Tracking Our Website uses cookies and similar technologies, including Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, the Meta (Facebook) Pixel, and Google reCAPTCHA, to understand how visitors use the Website, measure and improve our advertising, and protect our forms from spam. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect how parts of the Website work. 6. Information Stored Outside Canada Some of our suppliers and service providers are located outside Canada, including in the United States and your travel destination countries (such as Saudi Arabia for Umrah and Hajj travel). Your information may be processed in those countries and may be subject to their laws. 7. How Long We Keep Your Information We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described above, and as required by law, including TICO record-keeping rules and tax requirements. When it is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it. 8. How We Protect Your Information We use reasonable physical, electronic, and administrative safeguards, including encrypted (HTTPS) connections and restricted staff access, to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your data and will notify you and the authorities of a breach where required by law. 9. Your Rights You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, and withdraw your consent to marketing. To make a request, contact our Privacy Officer (Section 12). We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada at priv.gc.ca. 10. Children’s Information Our Website is not directed to children. We collect information about minors only when a parent or guardian provides it to book travel for them. 11. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be posted on this page with its updated date. 12. Contact Us and Privacy Officer Privacy Officer: Muizz uddin Ahmed Matchless Travels Inc. 2550 Argentia Road, Suite 107, Mississauga, ON L5N 5R1, Canada Phone: (289) 643-6663 Email: contact@matchlesstravels.ca TICO Registration No. 50023988 13. Governing Law This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein, including PIPEDA. Any dispute will be handled exclusively by the courts located in the Province of Ontario. Welcome to our Matchless Travel Agency.
